# meca-rompe-gerudo (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F8, Campo de Entrenamiento Gerudo), A: both ADULT at the entrance; a hammer pillar's key and the cracked wall's key; B entering later.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 18-gerudo
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 226
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test key 0xe3e8c0193f9f543d = 1: queued within pilar..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0xe3e8c0193f9f543d \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within pilar..end
#! expect A coop: test key 0xdf3f38237e1df2f9 = 1: queued within pared..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: key64 0xdf3f38237e1df2f9 \(record \d+\) 0 -> 1 within pared..end
mark start
warp GerudoTrainingGround GerudoTrainingGround_FromGerudoFortress adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark pilar
key 0xe3e8c0193f9f543d 1   # Obj_FireTemple_HammerSlipPillar_A_01
wait 300
mark pared
key 0xdf3f38237e1df2f9 1   # Obj_GerudoTrainingGround_CrackWall_A_01
wait 300
mark tarde
wait 600
wait 300
mark end
